correctness.rationale: The graph, vertex subsets and all four degree stages are exhaustively defined. verify_morse.py enumerates all 16,383 nonempty masks, independently checks induced cycles by union/find and degree bounds, constructs a deterministic full matching and checks every oriented Hasse cover by topological sort, including 457, 2256, 8654, and 12791 faces and 225, 1121, 4326, 6391 matched pairs. Only critical cells are one 0-cell and respectively six 3-, thirteen 5-, one 6-, and eight 8-cells. Forman discrete-Morse CW theory yields exact integral sphere wedges because intermediate cell dimensions are absent. verify_homology.py separately enumerates forests by the edge/component identity and computes complete mod-two boundary ranks, agreeing in all degrees. Inclusion-induced reduced homology maps vanish since consecutive stages have nonzero homology in distinct dimensions; the resulting integral interval decomposition has exactly the asserted bars.

value.rationale: The point-line incidence graph of the Fano plane (Heawood graph) is a canonical 14-vertex cubic girth-six graph in extremal graph theory and combinatorial topology. The four levels d=0..3 are its entire natural induced-forest degree filtration, not an arbitrary numerical slice. Exact integral homotopy classifications of the previously untreated three upper levels reveal sphere dimensions 5, 6, 8 with ranks 13, 1, 8, providing a complete integral persistence module and concrete tests for forest-filtration general theory. The known d=0 term is context, not novelty. A finite natural example is valuable independently of an infinite-family theorem.
